components.name: Primary Submit Button
components.description: Full-width Deep Burgundy primary CTA used to submit the contact form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; border: 0; background-color: var(--burgundy, #8B1E3A); color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); padding: 13px 18px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.96875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--burgundy-hover, #A52647); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.65; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Copy Action Button
components.description: Compact burgundy-seamed utility button nested inside the direct email row.
components.css: .ds-btn-copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--burgundy-border, #6E2338); background-color: var(--bg-panel, #16191F); color: var(--text-primary, #ECEEF2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), border-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-btn-copy:hover { background-color: var(--burgundy, #8B1E3A); border-color: var(--burgundy, #8B1E3A); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-copy .ds-icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.css: .ds-mode-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background-color: var(--bg-ground, #0F1115); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #394050); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); padding: 4px; gap: 4px; } .ds-mode-btn { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #B4BAC6); padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); font-size: 0.84375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 200ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-mode-btn:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-mode-btn.ds-is-active { background-color: var(--burgundy, #8B1E3A); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-mode-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed graphite form field with strong-steel rest border and Rose Ink focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size: 0.84375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #ECEEF2); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background-color: var(--bg-input, #111318); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #394050); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); padding: 11px 13px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text-primary, #ECEEF2); caret-color: var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), background-color 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #939AA8); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #525B6E; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); background-color: #0D0F13; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-tray-chip { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted, #939AA8); background-color: var(--bg-panel, #16191F); border: 1px solid var(--border, #282D38); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); padding: 3px 10px; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); } .ds-parts-count { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); background-color: var(--burgundy-tint, #28131B); border: 1px solid var(--burgundy-border, #6E2338); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); padding: 4px 12px; }

components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; background-color: #111318; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(147, 154, 168, 0.22) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #282D38); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); } .ds-node { border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-node-core { background-color: var(--burgundy-tint, #28131B); border: 1px solid var(--burgundy-border, #6E2338); } .ds-node-bloat { background-color: rgba(22, 25, 31, 0.88); border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong, #394050); } .ds-node-role { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--burgundy-text, #F0A3B6); } .ds-node-bloat .ds-node-role { color: var(--text-muted, #939AA8); } .ds-node-name { font-size: 0.96875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-node-bloat .ds-node-name { color: var(--text-secondary, #B4BAC6); } .ds-node-note { font-size: 0.84375rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #B4BAC6); } .ds-node-bloat .ds-node-note { color: var(--text-muted, #939AA8); }

narrative.overview:
This visual system translates a pragmatic, KISS ("Keep It Simple, Stupid") full-stack engineering mindset into a calm, dark-first workbench. Rather than mimicking a glossy SaaS landing page or a stiff resume, surfaces sit in deep matte graphite with crisp cool-steel seams and generous rounded geometry, letting plain-spoken typography and interactive engineering proof carry the page.

Rich burgundy is the system's sole chromatic voice. It stays disciplined—marking active toggle states, the primary contact action, core architecture nodes, inline links, and keyboard focus rings—so every colored element signals either direct action or load-bearing meaning. Zero white ground, zero parchment, and zero gold appear anywhere in the system.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first matte graphite surfaces stepped through tonal elevation rather than drop shadows.
Single disciplined burgundy accent family across fills, tints, borders, and light rose ink.
Self-hosted Hanken Grotesk paired with JetBrains Mono for technical metadata, addresses, and tabular counts.
Flat architectural precision softened by generous rounded radii (16px panels, 10px controls, 999px pills).
Fast, restrained motion using an exponential ease-out curve (150ms–260ms) that collapses cleanly under reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: Burgundy is the only chromatic accent in the system; reserve solid Deep Burgundy (#8B1E3A) strictly for active toggle states and primary actions, and use Burgundy Tint (#28131B) plus Rose Ink (#F0A3B6) for secondary emphasis so the accent never saturates the dark canvas.

rules.name: The Dark-Ground Invariant
rules.body: Never introduce white, off-white, parchment, or gold surfaces; all elevation steps stay within the #0F1115–#1D212A cool-graphite ladder.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono only for technical identifiers, tabular counts, email/profile handles, and compact interactive controls—never for multi-sentence body prose.

rules.name: The Open-Hero Rule
rules.body: Set the primary display headline and lead directly on the Matte Graphite Ground (#0F1115) without wrapping them in a card or adding an eyebrow kicker above the headline.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows, ambient glows, or glass blur to panels, buttons, or inputs; communicate surface separation solely through tonal graphite steps and 1px steel or burgundy seams.

dos: Do step surfaces strictly through the cool-graphite ladder (#0F1115, #111318, #16191F, #1D212A) separated by 1px cool-steel seams (#282D38 / #394050).
Do keep Burgundy (#8B1E3A / #A52647 / #28131B / #F0A3B6) as the sole chromatic accent for active states, primary actions, core diagram emphasis, inline links, and focus rings.
Do self-host Hanken Grotesk and JetBrains Mono and apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to all numeric counters, durations, and business IDs.
Do keep radii nested proportionally (16px panel -> 14px stage -> 12px node -> 10px control -> 8px nested utility button) and use 999px for pills and chips.
Do use crisp 1.75px-stroke inline SVGs (15px–17px) for icons and honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by collapsing transitions and smooth scrolling.
donts: Don't introduce white, cream, parchment, or gold backgrounds, accents, or borders anywhere in the system.
Don't add drop shadows, neon glows, or glassmorphism blur to cards, buttons, or inputs; this system is flat by design.
Don't wrap the open hero display headline in a card or add eyebrow kickers above section headings.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for body paragraphs or prose descriptions; reserve it for metadata, handles, IDs, and compact technical labels.
Don't replace solid-vs-dashed border semantics inside architecture diagrams with decorative multi-color badges or rainbow status pills.
